objective: Validate the adopted ten-cell current Wiley schedule with the production page-scoped native RIS route, two complete ordered DOI passes, exact-date accounting, and both mandatory screenshots.

scope.pilot004_boundary: Pilot 004 supplied rendered DOI ledgers only. No Pilot 004 RIS, page, browser, screenshot, or attempt state enters this pilot.

date_window.purpose: fixed diagnostic window, not a final review search

controls.native_ris: Every first-pass source page is exported through Wiley's visible page-scoped RIS-with-abstracts flow and reconciled one-to-one and in order.
controls.screenshots: configured Advanced Search and hydrated first results page

acceptance_checks: All ten predeclared source cells complete from fresh page-zero state.
A2-mh and A2-mb both complete and form the adopted lossless A2 union.
B2 and BT2 complete across every native result page.
Each event has two equal complete ordered DOI passes and a stable source total.
Every source DOI has exactly one first-pass normalized native RIS record in the same order.
Every native RIS page batch reconciles its record count and DOI order to that rendered page.
Every source record receives included, excluded, or unresolved exact-date accounting from visible First published evidence.
Every event saves and hashes both mandatory sibling screenshots.
No prior pilot state, source limit, language limit, type facet, access filter, Subject term, proximity operator, or pair expansion is used.
stop_rules: Retry only a fresh isolated source-total or ordered-ID snapshot change, up to two attempts.
Stop on access, challenge, query, control, card, RIS, DOI, date, screenshot, output, or cleanup failure.
A failed attempt contributes no DOI, record, count, screenshot, or native export to a successful event.
Never overwrite an event, screenshot, failure receipt, assessment, or validation report.

additional_wildcards.trigger: More than the three accepted wildcard atoms are proposed.

controlled_vocabulary.trigger: A Wiley Subject descriptor is proposed as a free-text supplement.
